EQM00007.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mi>T</mi><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi></mrow></msubsup><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>T</mi><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi></mrow></msub><mo>+</mo><mo>∑</mo><msub><mi>β</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>180</mn><mo>∘</mo></msup><mspace width="1em"/><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mtext>360° で整える</mtext><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T_{\mathrm{end}}^{\mathrm{calc}}=T_{\mathrm{start}}+\sum\beta_i-n\times180^\circ\quad(\text{360° で整える})</annotation></semantics></math>

EQM00020.tex: S=\sqrt{\Delta X^2+\Delta Y^2},\qquad \tan T=\frac{\Delta Y}{\Delta X}

EQM00021.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mtext>ずれ</mtext><mo>≈</mo><mi>S</mi><mo>×</mo><mi>δ</mi><mtext> </mtext><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>100</mn><mo>×</mo><mfrac><msup><mn>60</mn><mrow><mo mathvariant="normal">′</mo><mo mathvariant="normal">′</mo></mrow></msup><msup><mn>206265</mn><mrow><mo mathvariant="normal">′</mo><mo mathvariant="normal">′</mo></mrow></msup></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>0.029</mn><mtext> </mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\text{ずれ}\approx S\times\delta\ [\mathrm{rad}]=100\times\frac{60''}{206265''}=0.029\ \mathrm{m}</annotation></semantics></math>
